card.name: Inside people's names in news
card.fires_on: Partway through a person's name in news or press-release text, such as a first-name piece, a middle initial, or the start of a surname. It also fires weakly on digits inside numbers like years or legal codes.

modes.label: Split personal names
modes.description: The marked piece sits inside a researcher's or official's name, before the rest of the surname.
modes.example: Peter<< Eng>>lund, Permanent Secretary of the Swedish Academy

modes.label: Middle initials
modes.description: The marked period or initial comes between a first name and surname in a credited researcher.
modes.example: Andrew S<<.>> Brack, M.D., and colleagues

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a year or legal code.
modes.example: The Florida Southern buildings were built between 19<<3>>9 and 19
